source_review.interpretation: The IPC detector emits the expected copy-range candidate, but the queue-bound source code shows a pre-read positive/max-length guard, exact-size destination and matching copy count. This source alone does not substantiate the queued CWE-125 claim. The finding is a candidate, not a confirmed vulnerability; absence of a demonstrated OOB read does not establish product safety.
